response.rationale: The item is a home category product (not electronics), not final sale, and delivered 9 days ago (within the 30-day standard window). RET-007 applies (days_since_delivery <= 30 and final_sale == False). No higher-priority rule applies: not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no fraud hold (RET-051), no goodwill grant needed (RET-050). The customer's reason for returning (no longer needed) does not affect eligibility.
